plugin.name: sonata-resize
plugin._long: Resize windows (Wayfire's resize, uses its options). With live off, only the window's background follows the pointer and the contents fade in at the new size on release.

option.name: fill
option._long: Sonata sets it per appearance (the window background).

option.name: double_click
option._short: Double-click on a window's top edge
option._long: As a double-click on its title bar: toggle-maximize, minimize or none (Settings sets it with the title bar's).
